description: Filter, compare, and reshape tabular records with a single data-ops tool.

tools.description:
Reshape, filter, and diff tabular records (a list of objects). One tool driven by `operation`:

- `select` / `rename` / `sort` / `dedupe` / `groupby` reshape via pandas (use `spec`).
- `filter` keeps rows where `field` `operator` `value` (eq/ne/gt/gte/lt/lte/contains/startswith/regex/in/is_null/not_null).
- `compare` diffs two record sets matched on `key`, reporting added/removed/changed rows.

When to use: Any time the user asks to pick columns, rename, sort, drop duplicates, summarize/count/sum by group, subset/where-clause records, or diff/reconcile two snapshots.

How to discover inputs: If records live in AIDP storage and the user hasn't named the path, FIRST call CatalogFileTool(operation='list', ...) or WorkspaceFileTool(operation='list', ...) to locate the file, then pass it as `source_uri` (for compare use `left_uri`/`right_uri`). Prefer the URI form (`master:cat.sch.vol:/file.csv` or `workspace:/path/file.json`) over inline `data`/`left`/`right`.

How to communicate: Report the resulting counts (rows kept, added/removed/changed) and show a few sample rows. Do not echo the entire table.

Examples: total revenue by region -> operation='groupby', source_uri='workspace:/exports/orders.csv', spec='{"by":["region"],"agg":{"revenue":"sum"}}'. Invoices over $1000 -> operation='filter', source_uri='master:fin.fin.exports:/q3.csv', field='amount', operator='gt', value='1000'. Diff two snapshots -> operation='compare', left_uri='workspace:/snap/a.json', right_uri='workspace:/snap/b.json', key='customer_id'.

schema.name: operation
schema.description: What to do. `select` keeps columns, `rename` relabels fields, `sort` orders rows, `dedupe` drops duplicates, `groupby` aggregates (all use `spec`). `filter` keeps rows matching `field`/`operator`/`value`. `compare` diffs `left`/`right` record sets on `key`.

schema.name: data
schema.description: Inline records for reshape/filter operations, as a JSON array of objects. Use only for small in-hand data; for stored files use `source_uri`. Ignored when `source_uri` is set, and unused by `compare` (which uses `left`/`right`). Example: `[{"amount":1200,"status":"open"}]`.

schema.name: spec
schema.description: Parameters for reshape operations (select/rename/sort/dedupe/groupby) as a JSON object string: select=`{"columns":["a","b"]}`, rename=`{"map":{"old":"new"}}`, sort=`{"by":["field"],"ascending":true}`, dedupe=`{"subset":["id"]}`, groupby=`{"by":["region"],"agg":{"revenue":"sum"}}`. Ignored by filter/compare.

schema.name: field
schema.description: [filter] The record field to test on each row. Must exist on the input objects. Example: `amount`, `status`, `name`.

schema.name: operator
schema.description: [filter] The comparison to apply. `eq`/`ne` equality, `gt`/`gte`/`lt`/`lte` numeric/date ordering, `contains`/`startswith` substring, `regex` pattern, `in` (value is a JSON array), `is_null`/`not_null` presence (no `value` needed).

schema.name: value
schema.description: [filter] The value to compare each record's `field` against. Strings compared as-is; numbers/booleans coerced. For `in`, pass a JSON array string like `["open","pending"]`. Not needed for `is_null` / `not_null`.

schema.name: left
schema.description: [compare] Inline left/old/baseline record set as a JSON array of objects. Use only for small in-hand data; for stored files use `left_uri`. Ignored when `left_uri` or a paired `source_uri` is set.

schema.name: right
schema.description: [compare] Inline right/new/current record set as a JSON array of objects. Use only for small in-hand data; for stored files use `right_uri`. Ignored when `right_uri` or a paired `source_uri` is set.

schema.name: key
schema.description: [compare] The field used to match rows across the two sets. Rows on one side only become `added`/`removed`; matched rows with differing fields become `changed`. Example: `customer_id`, `sku`, `id`.

schema.name: source_uri
schema.description: AIDP URI to read input records from (reshape/filter), overriding inline `data`. For `compare`, a single paired document `{"left":[...],"right":[...]}`. Format: `master:<catalog>.<schema>.<volume>:/<path>` or `workspace:/<path>`. Extension drives parsing: `.json`, `.jsonl`, `.csv`.

schema.name: left_uri
schema.description: [compare] AIDP URI to read the left/old record set from. Takes precedence over `source_uri` and inline `left`. Same URI grammar; extension drives parsing (`.json`/`.jsonl`/`.csv`).

schema.name: right_uri
schema.description: [compare] AIDP URI to read the right/new record set from. Takes precedence over `source_uri` and inline `right`. Same URI grammar; extension drives parsing (`.json`/`.jsonl`/`.csv`).

schema.name: dest_uri
schema.description: Optional AIDP URI to write the result to. Same URI grammar (`master:cat.sch.vol:/path` or `workspace:/path`). `.json` writes the full envelope; `.jsonl`/`.csv` writes the row list (reshaped/matched rows, or the `changed` rows for compare). The structured envelope is still returned to the caller.

_confDescriptions.max_rows: Cap on rows returned after a reshape operation (select/rename/sort/dedupe/groupby). Protects the agent context from large result sets.
_confDescriptions.max_results: Cap on matching records returned by `filter`.
_confDescriptions.tolerance: [compare] Numeric equality tolerance for float field comparisons. Values within this delta are treated as equal (set 0 for strict equality).
_confDescriptions.source_uri: Optional AIDP URI to read input records from instead of the inline 'data' field. Supports master:<catalog>.<schema>.<volume>:/<path> and workspace:/<path>.
_confDescriptions.dest_uri: Optional AIDP URI to write the result to. Extension (.json/.jsonl/.csv) controls the serialization.
